session_note: RI's General Assembly runs a 2025-2026 term but holds separate annual sessions with no automatic carryover: House and Senate floor activity for 2026 concluded 2026-06-11 (per votes.rilegislature.gov session calendars), and status.rilegislature.gov confirms bills 'held for further study' in one calendar-year session simply die -- 2025 bills (H6097, S0921) do not reappear in the 2026 session and the same sponsors/topics had to be refiled under entirely new 2026 bill numbers (e.g., H7695, S2346, S2776).

decisions.notes: Retrieved via status.rilegislature.gov's ASP.NET bill-search form (Session Year=2025, Bills=6097); the site has no static per-bill URL, so the evidence url is the search page itself. evidence.quote: 03/28/2025 Introduced, referred to Senate Commerce / 04/18/2025 Scheduled for hearing and/or consideration / 04/21/2025 Meeting postponed (04/22/2025) / 05/02/2025 Scheduled for hearing and/or consideration (05/06/2025) / 05/06/2025 Committee recommended measure be held for further study

decisions.notes: Correction: final disposition (dead, no carryover) is the same as the packet believed, but the mechanism was 'held for further study' after a postponed-then-rescheduled hearing, not 'tabled' as the news-sourced packet text stated.
